name: Приплюсни, проткни и искалечь
alt: Грозный молоток и канцелярский штырь расправились с безобидным листом бумаги.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, clear at 384x384. Funny expressive caricature, bold clean ink contours, loose watercolor and gouache on warm mottled parchment, saturated colors, chunky forms, strong silhouette. Centered subject with comfortable margins, minimal scenery, one visual joke. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, frame or panels. Original composition, not copied card art. Clear plausible anatomy, no unintended extra limbs. Subject: An absurdly dramatic desktop battle scene: one crumpled BLANK parchment sheet folded like an accordion, pierced by one normal brass desk paper spike, next to one chunky wooden mallet and a tiny pair of blunt scissors. No bodies, no gore. Paper curls form a comically shocked little face with only two simple eyes and mouth, no writing. Distinct separate objects, clear still life.
